vb_textbox.text: I couldn't quite figure out a distinct pattern that helped me earn more points, however, I found what did help me was not falling for some sort of sunken cost fallacy - to stick with options where you haven't won a lot for a while. The opposite works too, when you've won a lot, choosing the same option may give you a further high reward. However, like I said, I still couldn't figure out a distinct clear pattern.
